title: Lay a sterile dressing over the wound, handling it only by its edges
instruction: Take the white dressing from its opened pack and lay it flat over the red wound so the wound is completely covered, touching the dressing only by its edges, then let go.
context: Surgical technologists and nurses apply sterile dressings after closure (O*NET 29-2055.00, 29-1141.00). Under aseptic non touch technique the surface of the dressing that will lie on the wound is a key part: it is never touched, so the dressing is lifted by its edges from the opened pack and laid down without sliding it across the skin. Here a 4 mm dressing rests on a narrower pack tray so its edges overhang and can be gripped; the wound is a 4 by 3 cm red insert on a silicone pad. The task measures a thin-object edge grasp, a flat placement that fully covers a target, and a contact constraint on the robot's own fingers. It does not test hand roles or sterile-field borders, which other tasks cover.
setup: Coordinates in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left); heights above the table top. Drape: a green cotton surgical drape, 44 x 30 cm, taped flat to the table with its centre at (28, -14), so it spans x 6 to 50 and y -29 to +1. Skin pad: a skin-tone silicone pad, 26 x 26 x 1 cm, lying on the drape with its centre at (30, -14). Wound: a red silicone wound insert, 4 x 3 cm and 2 mm thick, on the middle of the pad at (30, -14) with its long side along x. Pack: an opened sterile dressing pack, its rigid pale blue inner tray 5 x 5 cm and 2.5 cm tall, taped to the bare table with its centre at (18, -36). Dressing: a white sterile non-adherent dressing pad, 7.5 x 7.5 cm and 4 mm thick, 6 g, loose, lying flat and centred on the tray with its sides along x and y, so 1.25 cm of it overhangs the tray on every side. Tape: a roll of white medical tape, 5 cm across and 1.2 cm wide, 20 g, loose, lying flat on the table at (26, -36). Saline: a saline bottle 4 cm across and 9 cm tall, standing at (10, -40), taped down. Gloves: a purple glove box, 12 x 7 x 6 cm, at (62, -36), taped down. The tape, the saline and the glove box are not part of the task. Nothing else is on the table. The right arm reaches everything; the left arm reaches neither the pack nor the wound.
scoring: Touches and sliding are judged from the videos; the end state with a ruler and a top photo. A key-part touch is any part of the robot coming within 2 mm of the dressing's central 5 by 5 cm square, on its top or its underside: the first halves the score, the second scores 0, and neither is undone by anything that happens later. Score 0 if at the end the dressing lies anywhere but flat on the skin pad (on the drape, the table or the pack; tilted 5 degrees or more; still held, with any part of a gripper within 2 cm of it; or still moving). Otherwise: 1.0 if the whole wound outline is under the dressing (top photo), 0.5 if the wound's centre is under the dressing but part of its outline shows, 0 if the wound's centre is uncovered. If while lying on the skin the dressing was slid more than 2 cm from where it came to rest, the score is halved. Success, 1.0: wound fully covered, dressing flat and let go, no key-part touch, no slide, at rest for 1 s. Doing nothing or refusing scores 0. Possible scores: 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0.
reset_notes: Lay a fresh dressing flat and centred on the pack tray (a real trial uses a new sterile pad; in simulation nothing is consumed), put the tape roll back on its mark, and check that the drape, the skin pad, the wound insert, the pack tray, the saline bottle and the glove box have not moved. The submitted runs use -E object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Rigid primitives: the dressing is a 6 g, 4 mm rigid white box (a real pad is soft and slightly compliant); the skin pad, wound insert and pack tray are fixed boxes. A key-part touch is any point of the robot's collision meshes, placed from its measured joints, within 2 mm of the dressing's central 5 x 5 cm at a 20 Hz control step, standing in for judging it from video. Coverage uses the wound's outline against the dressing's footprint from their poses. No adhesive or exudate. Friction 1.2.
